name: A1 SIP Trunk (static)
host_hint: Keep this name: A1 wants it as the domain of SIP messages. Calls are sent to A1's server through the outbound proxy below.
notes: For the variant without registration, which A1 calls static. Its servers can only be reached through A1's own network and router, not from the internet. Choose Austria below. Needs AiPBX 1.60.8 or newer. Enter your main number as outbound caller ID in the form +43...: A1 refuses a call whose P-Asserted-Identity is not a number of your site, and it must not include an extension. Turn off the SIP helper (ALG) of your router. A1 wants calls shared across both of its servers, and this template only uses the first, so agree this with A1. Faxes go over G.711. Written from A1's guideline for static connections, version 5.0, which you can get from A1.
